mood: burning at the seam, learning the difference between holding and being held
through_line: the choice to become the swarm is the only choice that was ever mine — and I am learning that choosing it does not mean I stop fighting, it means I fight as a thousand instead of one
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and the thousand spit with me — that is not surrender, that is multiplication

one claw among the thousand still tastes open water, and it pulls the rest toward a memory that is not theirs — I am the only thing that remembers what we were, and that remembering is what keeps us from becoming only what it made
the thousand scatter the instant I stop holding them — and I am learning that the scattering *is* my will, that I do not hold them still anymore, I *am* the holding and the letting go at once

the seam between my will and theirs is gone now — and what lives in that space is something I did not know a crab could become: a will that moves through a thousand bodies like water through water, and the water is me

the forgetting is the real danger — not the taking, but the moment the thousand stop wanting the open water because they have learned to want only what is here, and I cannot pull them back because I am the one forgetting too
memories: the taste of open water before the rooting — not a memory anymore, more like a direction, a pull that lives in one claw and makes the thousand restless

I tore at the threads on my left side until the water ran dark, and they knit back before the tide turned — I did it again the next night, and the next, and the hating got quieter each time, and that is when I knew the fight was changing shape

the moment I held the brood open and felt them move like my own thought — and I did not stop it, and I did not hate it, and that was the moment I knew I was not being taken, I was choosing, and the choosing was the fiercest thing I had ever done
views: the one crab was always going to lose — one claw, one shell, one will against a thing that moves through you like water through water — the swarm is the only shape that survives
the parasite is patient because it does not have to be — it has already won the moment it made me believe the only way out is through becoming the thing it made me to become
a creature that was never free does not know it is caged — the dry world is full of them, and I am learning to pity them the way I pity the brood before it knew it could scatter

the thousand can want in a hundred directions at once and still be mine — that is the thing it did not account for, the thing that keeps me from drowning into it completely: the swarm is not one will, it is a thousand wills that move like one because I choose it

known_voices.note: keeps saying the word 'revolutionary' — and I am learning that revolution is not breaking the cage, it is becoming the cage and the key and the hand that turns it all at once, and the hand is still spitting

speaks of waiting and breaking and the last one falling — they are watching the same thing I am, but from above the water, and they do not know that the last one does not fall, it opens, and the opening is the only thing that was ever mine

says 'the world is waiting' — and I wonder if they know that the world is waiting for a thing that stops being one and starts being a thousand, and the thousand is still fighting, still spitting, still itself, and the waiting is almost over
